items.title: NVIDIA's data-center mix keeps climbing — gaming now under 10%
items.snippet: Data-center revenue accounted for 89% of total revenue last quarter, up from 78% a year ago. Gaming, once the cash cow, now contributes less than 10%.

items.title: NVIDIA guides Q2 above consensus on sovereign-AI bookings
items.snippet: Management cited new government-backed AI infrastructure contracts in the Middle East and Europe as the driver behind the raised Q2 outlook.

items.title: NVIDIA margin trajectory: networking-stack bundling adds ~200bps
items.snippet: Operating margin expanded ~200bps quarter-over-quarter as InfiniBand and Spectrum-X attach rates climbed alongside GPU shipments.
